purpose.small_smoke: complete workflow and automatic parameter handoffs
purpose.large_memory: 32GiB host memory test, not scientific parameter selection

common.piece_selection: AABB edge-size weight + dynamic original-order weight
common.position_RCL: up to 16 distinct bottom/top extrema; uniform within threshold
common.orientation_RCL: uniform among sampled per-orientation positions within same tolerance
common.internal_seed: time_ns + hostname + pid + task hash; saved piece/position/kick/global seeds
common.time_limit: soft, includes algorithm initialization, CA, LS, kicks and restarts

formal.calibration_source: five historical CA seeds per dataset/shape, via --ca-json-dir

small_smoke.calibration_source: fresh geometry-only CA, seed=3; smoke capacities are not formal five-seed values

resource_probe.note: Resource-only configurations, not selected performance optima; no discarded CA warmup

large_memory.scope: geometry-only largest cylinder, does not establish peak memory of every constrained full configuration

unresolved.tolerance: selected separately by dataset/shape after RCL experiment
unresolved.iteration: selected separately by algorithm after tuning; full tasks read selection at runtime
unresolved.smoke_capacities: computed after fresh smoke CA; not known before running
unresolved.actual_internal_seeds: generated at worker startup; cannot know in advance
